card.name: Needle recapping warnings, and scattered dose words
card.fires_on: Mainly the word 'be' or 'not' in 'needles should not be recapped' in needle-stick safety text. Weaker on small linking words in dosing or drug-interaction sentences.

modes.label: Needle recapping warning
modes.description: Words just before 'recapped' in needle-stick injury instructions.
modes.example: To prevent needle-stick injuries, needles should not<< be>> recapped.

modes.label: Dosing and interaction linking words
modes.description: Small words or units in dosing tables and drug-interaction sentences, such as 'on', 'with', 'mg', 'of'.
modes.example: Patients<< on>> hemodialysis or Peritoneal dial
